name: Mineral Tycoon ⛏
desc:
Welcome to Mineral Tycoon!
 
Upgrade and expand you mineral empire!

Rebirth and unlock new floors!

Mine ore around the map and collect airdrops for bonus cash!

PVP Combat!

Better guns and pickaxes can be found in the garage!

Join the group for a free chat tag and 10% cash boost!
https://www.roblox.com/groups/34600041

Please report any bugs to the server! 

Lots of new features and tycoon expansions coming soon!

PC Controls:

Car Lights - L
Sprint - Left Ctrl
Aim Gun - F
Interact - E
